methodology: Discovery shortlist requires a Rivo sports row with at least 50 reported settled trades, win rate above 50%, reported profit >= $50K and return >= 5%; final admission additionally requires the stricter independent Polymarket sample below.
Rivo sports leaderboards supply candidate addresses; Polymarket v2 user-stats verifies realized_pnl and economic_pnl, and latest activity verifies recency.
Fetch both CLOSED and OPEN positions with cursor pagination. Resolved holdings can remain OPEN and must be included to avoid hiding unredeemed losses. Reject incomplete position pagination.

Historical sample uses game starts within the last 90 days; exact matched Gamma market must be closed with a known gameStartTime. Require first_entry_at before gameStartTime, current_price exactly 0 or 1, avg_price between .02 and .98, and total_size * avg_price >= $100. Sports tags use the existing scanner classifier.

Exclude each condition with material positions on more than one outcome across CLOSED and OPEN rows. Aggregate API total_pnl by event slug, collapsing -more-markets suffix, for event profit, profit factor, return and largest-win removal. Outcome win rate separately counts qualifying positions whose terminal price is 1.
Preserve all prior 55 wallets, filters and global conviction ranking; add the 20 new wallets to dashboard and Discord CORE in sync.
limitations: This is a retrospective selected sample, not an out-of-sample test, complete lifetime win rate, or verified predictive edge. Selection and survivorship bias remain.

First entry before game time does not prove every subsequent fill was pregame. Historical average entry and position sizes do not reproduce executable copy fills, slippage, or fees a follower would pay.
Markets in the same event or tournament can be correlated. Event slugs do not always uniquely identify independent matches.

Specialties are descriptive; the scanner continues scanning every sport for every wallet. Lifetime realized profit can differ from the recent directional sports sample, economic P&L and Rivo tracked-trade profit.
Records are snapshots of public endpoints; prices, activity, names and profit can change. No qualifying current position is required to retain a researched wallet.
